Then the hypothesis is rigorously tested, and evidence is collected. If the evidence all supports the hypothesis, and none disproves it, then it becomes a theory. Once the body of evidence becomes truly overwhelming and massive, then we say that it is a Proven Theory. Evolutionary theory is a proven theory - it is the closest that science can ever come to producing an absolute truth. There are no remaining doubts about it. Not even one. There is no evidence that does not support it. None at all. So, if you want to question accepted science, then you need to actual do science and research. You need to present material facts that contradict the hypothesis or theory, and they need to have been collected using rational, rigorous methods. You need to actually scientifically DISPROVE a theory in order to effectively overturn it.
